promotion_hold.decision: HELD as candidate by owner direction 2026-10-04 (strict-nine promotion).
promotion_hold.reason: OQ-TEN-1 (C13) directly affects the Membership entity's shape: the owner has not yet decided between the Gate A single-location compatibility membership model and a normalized multi-organization, multi-location model (see TEN-15). Promoting Membership now would risk approving an entity whose structure may change.
promotion_hold.consequence: CreateMembership, DeactivateMembership, and RevokeMembership remain approved but carry a documented exception to SEM-36 (approved-depends-on-approved) until Membership is promoted. See the validator's MEMBERSHIP_HOLD_EXCEPTION list.
promotion_hold.release_condition: Owner resolves OQ-TEN-1; Membership then re-evaluated against the promotion gate.
